description:
Our client is on the cutting edge of situational awareness and airborne navigational display technology. In short, displays for aircraft, plus stuff that's much more complex than that.
 Due to the growth of their business, they have an immediate need to add TWO Software Developers to their team in Sarasota Florida. 
 Sarasota is a magnificent place to live, with both a low cost of living and high quality of life 12 months of the year. Enjoy sitting by your pool and walking on the beach while your friends are freezing up North! 

 Our client is truly at the front end of this truly innovative technology and they are looking for people who will be genuinely interested in the work and in being highly creative in problem solving. 

 
 
 *Some relocation assistance is available* 

 Requirements: 
 US Citizenship
 Strong expertise in C++
 Eager, Motivated, Intelligent
 Able to travel to Europe occasionally for training
 *Knowledge of DO-178B would be a big plus, but is not required* 


 This is an opportunity we are looking to hire asap, please apply soon! 
 

 We are looking for new grads as well as men and women with up to 5 years experience.
